Use /poteto-mode. It selects the Code review playbook for a branch and can call /interrogate when a multi-model adversarial review is warranted.

    /poteto-mode Review this branch against main. Report blocking issues with file and line references, and verify each finding. Do not modify code.

Use /interrogate directly only when you specifically want several models to challenge the diff without applying fixes.

Sources:
https://github.com/mdsmithaustin/pstack/blob/main/poteto-mode/SKILL.md
https://github.com/mdsmithaustin/pstack/blob/main/interrogate/SKILL.md
